verified_changes.finding: For nonempty original read_roots, run_setup_full directly calls the same run_read_acl_only at the former detached-helper branch. The original deny-read stage stays before it; runtime/write/deny stages stay after. Empty roots preserve the explicit skip.

All recorded read-stage errors now return Err for initial Full and explicit non-refresh ReadAclsOnly as well as refresh. The unchanged run_setup commits the initial marker only after its mode body returns Ok. Existing real_main and orchestrator paths preserve nonzero propagation.

The pinned require_logon_sandbox_creds optionally performs initial setup, then unconditionally runs Full refresh for the current roots before returning credentials. The read stage is therefore included in that existing awaited operation.

The fixed Local name/default descriptor/noninheritance remain. Only a newly created mutex yields a guard. Existing objects return an error with raw io OS183 after closing the newly opened non-owner handle; no existing object is treated as a completion receipt.

Production guard ReleaseMutex/CloseHandle body is byte-identical and remains in one synchronous setup thread. The test independent OpenMutex handle uses OwnedHandle. No new wait loop, subprocess, environment mutation or production-name test is added.

new_control_review.name: win::read_acl_mutex::tests::existing_read_acl_mutex_is_not_a_completion_receipt
physical_api_steps: Create and own an isolated Local mutex.
Second CreateMutex acquisition returns io OS183 plus not-ready context.
Open a separate real handle, drop the owner and retain the unowned object.
The retained object still produces OS183 rather than readiness.
Drop the final retained handle; a new owner can then be created.
new_control_review.leak_observation: The final recreation also depends on the competing non-owner handles having been closed; the source does not replace real kernel objects with a fake mutex.
new_control_review.narrow_scope: This single-thread actual Win32 object control verifies named-object ownership/retention behavior, not cross-process completed payloads or actual Full read ACL success.

target_selection.source_chain: Cargo binds codex-windows-sandbox-setup to src/bin/setup_main/main.rs; its Windows-only win module imports read_acl_mutex, whose cfg(test) module imports the new test. defs.bzl generates a separate <binary>-bin-unit-tests outer wrapper and BUILD keeps its Windows platform constraint.
target_selection.cargo_limit: A --lib-only invocation cannot include this new helper test. The original whole package entrypoint or the explicit existing Bazel helper target must supply its own actual roster and result.

compatibility_and_limits: Busy or retained named objects now fail an otherwise legitimate concurrent request. The session-wide name is not keyed by read roots and provides no cross-process completion record; identical same-process payload singleflight remains unchanged.

The initial non-elevated and refresh Command::status calls have no local timeout; elevated WaitForSingleObject(INFINITE) and singleflight Condvar remain unbounded. Synchronous read work can increase startup latency. This is not a bounded readiness implementation.

The OS183 cause is preserved in the anyhow chain and detailed debug log. Unchanged real_main maps it to HelperUnknownError with the top-level not-ready context in the JSON report; that message is not guaranteed to include the numeric OS code.

Original missing-path and builtin/group RX shortcuts remain. Successful completion means the existing read stage returned normally, not that a future full-restricting read SID, every descendant, or protected children are authorized.

No rollback is added: earlier provisioning, deny-read or partial ACL effects may remain after failure. Path replacement, concurrent ACL writers, root drift, normal loader, descendant lifetime and cancellation remain outside this patch.

No Rust formatting, compilation, Windows execution, Full/refresh endpoint or performance/concurrency qualification was performed in this review. The original library target and separate helper target retain their own results.

primary_api_basis.meaning: Existing named objects ignore initial-owner request; release requires ownership; last-handle closure ends object lifetime. These primary API semantics support the source review but do not substitute for Windows execution.

reviewer_correction_limit: Two local source-input adapter errors stopped before git patch application. They were corrected without changing the candidate or any native input; the exact byte checks and the final independent four-command reconstruction then passed.
blocker_status: B11 remains OPEN. No original exit condition is changed and no native execution is authorized by this review.
